# Test fixtures

Small files that live in git and that the tests read. Rules
(`CONTRIBUTING.md`):

- Every photo or video is reviewed by the owner, picture and metadata,
  before it is committed. Each file's row below is that review record.
- No dive logs here or anywhere in git. Tests that need a log build a
  synthetic one at run time.
- `deco_reference/` holds Subsurface planner output the deco engine is
  checked against (no device or personal data); its README is the Python
  repo's, see the note at its top.
- `python_reference/` holds fixtures generated by the Python app (the
  `/fixtures` skill); each area there has its own README with the Python
  commit and the command that made each file.

## Media

Copied unchanged from the Python repo's `tests/fixtures/media/` on
2026-10-17 (Python commit `b145e5a`), checksums verified against its
README; the owner approved copying the Python repo's test content. The
rows are its review records.

How the media was made: `scripts/make_test_fixtures.py` in the Python repo
builds the files from the owner's `test_data/release_test`. Each file is
re-encoded smaller with all metadata stripped, then only an allowlist of
tags the app reads is copied back: creation dates and time zones, plus
camera make/model for photos and the recording path for DJI clips. Serial
numbers, shutter counts, lens data, maker notes, GPS and thumbnails never
carry over. A rebuilt file has a different checksum, so it needs a new
review before it replaces the committed file.

Owner's decisions on what may be in git (2026-11-13): invented dive logs,
FIT files included, and the small ffmpeg test-pattern clips may be kept as
base64 or text inside the fixture JSON; the skin PNGs of the bundled
overlay templates are committed under `assets/`. A real log, photo or
video still needs the owner's review of each file.
